title: pvConvertIntoMolecule
body:
## pvConvertIntoMolecule

Turns a point set (polydata, unstructured grid or another vtkPointSet) into a molecule (vtkMolecule): every point becomes an atom at the same position, its element read from a one-component point array of atomic numbers, and the other point arrays become atom data. With ConvertLinesIntoBonds (ParaView default true) each line cell becomes a bond. Use it to bring particle or simulation output into the chemistry operations pvComputeMoleculeBonds, pvAppendMolecule and pvMoleculeToLines.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The array must hold element numbers (1 hydrogen, 6 carbon, 8 oxygen…), not a simulation code's atom-type indices; remap types upstream, e.g. with calculator.
- If no atomic-number array is selected and the input has no active point scalars, the native filter fails with "does not have atomic numbers as input".
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertIntoMolecule`. Identity: `filters/PointSetToMolecule`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AtomicNumbers` | This property indicates the name of the scalar array corresponding to atomic numbers. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ConvertLinesIntoBonds` | This property determines if the lines (cell of type VTK_LINE) are converted into bonds. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvConvertIntoMolecule",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
